repo.description: GitHub owner/repository, without a URL or credentials.

cache.description: Directory containing the committed RFC snapshot used offline or when GitHub is unavailable.

scope.description: Scope assigned to imported records: org, a context, or <context>.<service>.

labels.description: Labels an issue or pull request must have. Multiple labels are combined with AND, matching GitHub's API.

titlePrefix.description: Case-insensitive title prefix, for repositories that identify RFCs by title instead of label.

idPrefix.description: Catalog id prefix. Defaults to the repository owner and name.

statusMap.description: Maps a label or GitHub open/closed state to the normalized lifecycle. A matching label wins over state.
